title: Hatsune Miku - NamuWiki
snippet:
On June 22, 2017, to commemorate the 10th anniversary of Hatsune Miku's birth, Sony released a collaboration model for the Walkman NW-A35 and Bluetooth speaker h.ear go (SRS-HG1). It is a limited-time and limited quantity until August 23rd, and to commemorate the 10th anniversary of not only Miku but also Vocaloid in general, limited models of Kagamine Rin , Kagamine Len and Megurine Luka are released at the same time.
